items.category: 1a mass flow - anode N2 / O2 (air surrogate)
items.required_spec: one MFC per pure gas, calibrated on its own gas in final orientation (SRC-SNYDER2017); envelope 0.030-3.14 mg/s (~106:1), >= 3 overlapping ranges per gas path (A4); N2 1.42-150.9 sccm-equivalent, O2 component <= 58.6 sccm (W1); every registered point >= 0.2 FS (PROPOSED); O2-service cleaned; R_arch needs repeatability only, absolute gate needs expanded u at each registered point

options.name: thermal-sensor MFC with laminar bypass (e.g. Bronkhorst EL-FLOW Select F-200CV/F-201CV)

key_specs.quantity: accuracy (incl. linearity, based on actual calibration)

key_specs.value: max 0.2 % at 90° off horizontal, 1 bar, N2

options.meets_requirement: PARTIAL: at 0.2 FS the bound is 0.5 % + 0.5 % = 1.0 % of reading (standard ranges) — consistent with I-U planning but not the 0.5 % per-reading repeatability path unless S1a shows it; thermal principle needs own-gas calibration (O2 and N2 separately)
options.calibration_route: factory calibration certificate (accreditation scope not verified here); own-gas verification against the S1a primary calibrator (item 1c)
options.limitations: gas-dependent sensor (GCF); orientation and temperature zero shifts; O2-service cleaning is an ordering option to confirm (not read)

options.name: laminar differential-pressure MFC with gas property library (e.g. Alicat MC mid-range 10 sccm-20 slpm)

key_specs.value: ±0.6 % Rd or ±0.1 % FS whichever greater / ±0.5 % Rd or ±0.1 % FS

options.meets_requirement: LIKELY for the upper two ranges on paper (0.6 % Rd bound); per-reading repeatability and own-gas calibration must be shown in CD-04
options.calibration_route: vendor calibration (ISO/IEC 17025 claim not verified here - verify); own-gas check against primary calibrator
options.limitations: '98 gases' are property-based conversions (REFPROP), i.e. not an own-gas calibration in the Snyder 2017 sense unless calibrated on O2/N2; wetted FKM seals - confirm O2 service option

options.name: Coriolis MFC (e.g. Bronkhorst mini CORI-FLOW ML120V21)

key_specs.value: any position; must be bolted to stiff mass for zero stability

options.meets_requirement: PARTIAL: gas-independent (no GCF), good for 0.3-3.14 mg/s; at the 0.030 mg/s envelope minimum the zero stability alone is ~9 % of reading - not usable there
options.calibration_route: gravimetric/any-fluid calibration transfers across gases (principle; verify certificate scope)
options.limitations: vibration-sensitive zero; low-end of envelope not covered
